description.form: Stocky knight in plain plate with one oversized tower shield.
description.decision: Choose which ally stands behind the shield.
description.positioning: Front row, facing the expected attackers, carry directly behind.
description.allies: Any fragile Mage, Sniper or Priest.
description.counterplay: Flank the shield or push him away from the protected ally.
description.recognition: The big shield glows and a short arc marks the guarded side.

skill.name: Shield Wall
skill.text: Always on. Attacks aimed at the ally standing behind the shield are weakened.

description.form: Big-shouldered orc with tusks, a boar-skull helm and a heavy club.
description.decision: Build a long run-up into a big first hit.
description.positioning: Far from the target with an open lane.
description.allies: Orcs for health; Fighters for damage.
description.counterplay: Screen or crowd the lane; block the landing cell.
description.recognition: Dust trail grows with momentum, then a streak on the charge.

skill.name: Tusk Charge
skill.text: Builds momentum while moving. With a clear straight path, charges and turns that momentum into one heavy hit.

description.form: Antlered elf elder in a leaf mantle with a twisted wooden staff.
description.decision: Anchor a healing zone the team fights inside.
description.positioning: Centre of the formation, where she will not need to walk.
description.allies: Tanks and Fighters who hold ground next to her.
description.counterplay: Burst her before the grove establishes, or displace her.
description.recognition: A ring of flowers grows on the healed cells and pulses.

skill.name: Sacred Grove
skill.text: After standing still, grows a healing area that pulses. It ends on moving, being pushed, being stunned or being defeated.

description.form: Wiry goblin with a metal jaw-guard and a hooked chain.
description.decision: Reach a distant enemy unless something stands in the way.
description.positioning: On a line with an unscreened enemy carry.
description.allies: Assassins; units that open lanes by pushing.
description.counterplay: Put a defender in the line.
description.recognition: The chain line is shown before the hook flies.

skill.name: Chain Hook
skill.text: Dashes in a straight line toward a distant enemy and hits the first enemy in the way.

description.form: Slim scholar in a long coat carrying a large floating crystal.
description.decision: Punish enemies lined up in rows and columns.
description.positioning: Protected back row with a clear view of the enemy cluster.
description.allies: Shieldbearer in front; Mages for the skill-damage bonus.
description.counterplay: Spread across rows and columns; interrupt the unreleased cast.
description.recognition: The crystal splits light into a visible cross before each beam fires.

skill.name: Crossfire
skill.text: Marks a cell, then fires one beam along its row and a second beam along its column.

description.form: Water-bodied figure with a wave-shaped crest and trailing droplets.
description.decision: Break a formation by pushing its front unit away.
description.positioning: On the lane holding the enemy's key front-liner.
description.allies: Shieldbearer's counter; allies that punish displaced units.
description.counterplay: Stagger the formation; block the push cell.
description.recognition: A wave rolls down the lane and carries one enemy back.

skill.name: Tidal Wave
skill.text: Damages enemies in the lane it faces and pushes the first one back through free cells.

description.form: Thin horned demon carrying a hanging iron cage on a chain.
description.decision: Take one enemy out of the fight.
description.positioning: Behind a defender, within reach of approaching enemies.
description.allies: Shieldbearer; allies that focus the caged unit.
description.counterplay: Interrupt the wind-up; pressure him during the long cooldown.
description.recognition: The cage flies out and closes around one enemy.

skill.name: Soul Cage
skill.text: Throws a cage at one enemy. The caged enemy cannot move, attack or cast for a short time. Deals no damage.

description.form: Robed cleric with a tall hood and a large lantern staff.
description.decision: Keep one key ally alive through burst.
description.positioning: Back row, away from Assassin landing cells.
description.counterplay: Dive her with Assassins or silence her.
description.recognition: A beam of light links the lantern to the healed ally.

skill.name: Mending Light
skill.text: Heals the allied unit with the lowest health.

description.form: Short broad dwarf with a braided beard and a huge two-handed hammer.
description.decision: Lock down the unit in front of him.
description.positioning: Front row opposite a dangerous melee enemy.
description.allies: Dwarves for shields; Fighters for damage.
description.counterplay: Kite him with ranged units.
description.recognition: The hammer glows, then an impact star appears over the target.

skill.name: Stunning Blow
skill.text: Strikes the current target and stuns it briefly.

description.form: Massive orc with stone gauntlets and a single shoulder plate.
description.decision: Stop a melee pile-up around him.
description.positioning: Front row where enemies gather.
description.counterplay: Do not surround him; use ranged units.
description.recognition: Raised fists, then cracks spread to adjacent cells.

skill.name: Ground Slam
skill.text: Slams the ground and stuns all adjacent enemies.

description.form: Round bear-headed bruiser with huge paws and a leather harness.
description.decision: Punish enemies that cluster around him.
description.positioning: Front row.
description.counterplay: Fight him one at a time or from range.
description.recognition: A wide claw arc sweeps around him.

skill.name: Wide Swipe
skill.text: Hits every adjacent enemy with one swipe.

description.form: Tiny green goblin with big ears carrying a round bomb as large as his torso.
description.decision: Cheap early area damage.
description.positioning: Second row.
description.counterplay: Spread out; he is fragile.
description.recognition: A lit fuse, an arc, and a small blast circle.

skill.name: Lobbed Bomb
skill.text: Throws a bomb that damages a small area around the target.

description.form: Small floating flame spirit with two round eyes and tiny arms.
description.decision: Cheap early protection.
description.positioning: Behind the front line.
description.counterplay: Burst through the shield.
description.recognition: A warm bubble surrounds the shielded ally.

skill.name: Warm Ward
skill.text: Places a small shield on the ally with the lowest health.

description.form: Heavy orc with painted arms beating a large waist drum.
description.decision: Speed up a melee group at the right moment.
description.positioning: Just behind the front line, next to Fighters.
description.counterplay: Kill the buffed group's back support; stun during the buff.
description.recognition: Red rings pulse out from the drum.

skill.name: War Drum
skill.text: Raises the attack speed of nearby allies for a few seconds.

description.form: Broad artillerist with goggles wheeling a short fat cannon.
description.decision: Reward enemy clumping with area damage.
description.positioning: Far back row; needs time to charge.
description.allies: Tanks that hold enemies together; Engineers for mana.
description.counterplay: Spread out or reach him quickly.
description.recognition: A marked circle appears before the shell lands.

skill.name: Siege Shell
skill.text: Lobs a shell at the largest group of enemies in reach, dealing magic damage to everyone within 1 cell.

description.form: Slender archer with long ears, a green hood and a bow taller than herself.
description.decision: Line up shots through several enemies.
description.positioning: Back row on a column the enemy fills.
description.allies: Other Snipers; a Tank in front.
description.counterplay: Stagger columns; send Assassins.
description.recognition: The arrow leaves a thin bright trail through its line.

skill.name: Piercing Arrow
skill.text: Shoots an arrow through the current target that damages every enemy in that line.

description.form: Lean masked elf with two crescent blades and a short cape.
description.decision: Remove the enemy's farthest back-line unit.
description.positioning: Anywhere; she relocates when her skill fires.
description.allies: Other Assassins to overload the back line.
description.counterplay: Keep a bodyguard near the back-line carry.
description.recognition: A crescent flash at the start cell and behind the target.

skill.name: Moon Step
skill.text: Blinks behind the farthest enemy and strikes it with a guaranteed critical hit (150% damage).

description.form: Tall elf in bark armour holding a glowing seed.
description.decision: Add a disposable front-liner that pulls attacks.
description.positioning: Second row so the treant appears in front.
description.counterplay: Area damage clears the treant; ignore it with Assassins.
description.recognition: The seed is thrown and a treant bursts from the cell.

skill.name: Call Treant
skill.text: Summons a treant beside her. It fights until it falls and taunts the enemies next to it.

description.form: Squat dwarf sealed in thick armour with two bolted shields.
description.decision: Force nearby enemies to hit the toughest unit.
description.positioning: Front and centre.
description.allies: Priests and Warlocks that heal him.
description.counterplay: Skill damage ignores armour; kill his back line first.
description.recognition: Shields slam together and red lines pull enemy attention.

skill.name: Hold Fast
skill.text: Braces for 4 seconds, gaining armour, and taunts adjacent enemies for 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds: they must attack him.

description.form: Dwarf with a wide hat and a rifle longer than he is tall.
description.decision: Pressure the enemy back line from safety.
description.positioning: Back corner.
description.allies: Snipers for range; a Tank screen.
description.counterplay: Assassins; put a Tank farthest away as bait.
description.recognition: A long aiming line appears before the shot.

skill.name: Long Shot
skill.text: Fires one heavy shot at the farthest enemy for physical damage.

description.form: Crowned dwarf riding a chunky walking forge with rocket racks.
description.decision: Late-game area damage across the whole enemy board.
description.positioning: Back row, well protected.
description.allies: Engineers for mana; Dwarves for shields.
description.counterplay: Kill or silence him before the barrage; spread out.
description.recognition: Racks open, rockets arc up and target marks appear.

skill.name: Rocket Barrage
skill.text: Launches 3 rockets at the positions of random enemies. Each deals magic damage to everyone within 1 cell.

description.form: Hunched goblin in a feathered mask shaking a bone rattle.
description.decision: Weaken the enemy's main attacker.
description.positioning: Mid row, facing the enemy carry.
description.counterplay: Skill-based damage is unaffected.
description.recognition: A purple mark hangs over the weakened enemy.

skill.name: Jinx
skill.text: Hits the current target for magic damage and lowers its attack damage for 4 seconds.

description.form: Skinny goblin in a leaf cloak with a long blowpipe.
description.decision: Wear down one high-health enemy.
description.positioning: Back row.
description.counterplay: Healing outlasts the poison; dive him.
description.recognition: Green bubbles rise from the poisoned unit.

skill.name: Poison Dart
skill.text: Poisons the current target for 4 seconds: magic damage every second, and it attacks more slowly.

description.form: Tall orc in a bone headdress with a skull-topped staff.
description.decision: Sustain himself against grouped enemies.
description.positioning: Second row near the fight.
description.counterplay: Spread out; burst him.
description.recognition: Red threads link him to each drained enemy.

skill.name: Draining Chain
skill.text: Drains the current target, then up to 2 more enemies within 2 cells of each one hit, for magic damage, and heals himself.

description.form: Small fox-headed fighter with a big tail and two claws.
description.decision: Early back-line pressure.
description.positioning: A flank column.
description.counterplay: Guard the back line with a cheap melee unit.
description.recognition: Orange blur on the leap; red drops on the bleeding unit.

skill.name: Pounce
skill.text: Leaps onto the current target from up to 4 cells away, strikes it for physical damage and makes it bleed for 4 seconds.

description.form: Wolf-headed hunter with a fur mantle and a horn.
description.decision: Add bodies to the front line.
description.positioning: Second row with free cells in front.
description.counterplay: Area damage clears wolves.
description.recognition: A horn call, then two wolves jump in.

skill.name: Pack Call
skill.text: Summons 2 wolves beside her. They fight until they fall. A side may have 4 summoned units at once.

description.form: Owl-headed sage in a feather cloak with a crooked staff.
description.decision: Remove the most dangerous enemy from the fight for a moment.
description.positioning: Mid row within reach of the enemy carry.
description.allies: Shamans; burst damage to finish the hexed unit.
description.counterplay: Bait the hex with a less important unit.
description.recognition: A puff of feathers and a tiny critter in the enemy's place.

skill.name: Small Fry
skill.text: Turns the current target into a harmless critter for 2.5 / 3.5 / 5 seconds. It can walk, but cannot attack, cast or gain mana.

description.form: Red horned warrior with one burning greatsword.
description.decision: Deal steady damage in a melee pile.
description.positioning: Front row.
description.counterplay: Keep melee away; focus him.
description.recognition: A ring of flame circles his feet.

skill.name: Burning Aura
skill.text: Ignites for 4 seconds: every second, all adjacent enemies take magic damage. The fire moves with him.

description.form: Dark winged demon with glowing eyes and long claws.
description.decision: Cut through a column of enemies.
description.positioning: On a column the enemy fills.
description.counterplay: Stagger columns.
description.recognition: A dark streak across the dashed cells.

skill.name: Shadow Dash
skill.text: Dashes up to 4 cells in a straight line through the current target, dealing physical damage to every enemy on that line.

description.form: Huge horned demon with a burning crown and a heavy whip.
description.decision: Deny a large area of the board.
description.positioning: Back row, protected.
description.allies: Mages; Tanks that hold enemies in the area.
description.counterplay: Move out, spread, or silence him.
description.recognition: The area darkens, then fire falls in waves.

skill.name: Rain of Fire
skill.text: Calls fire down around the current target for 4 seconds: every second, enemies within 2 cells of that spot take magic damage.

description.form: Skeleton in a torn hood with a bow made of ribs.
description.decision: Soften a tank for physical damage.
description.positioning: Back row.
description.counterplay: Assassins; armour matters less against skill damage.
description.recognition: A cracked-shield mark over the target.

skill.name: Splinter Arrow
skill.text: Shoots the current target for physical damage and lowers its armour for 5 seconds.

description.form: Veiled ghoul with long sleeves and a floating curse doll.
description.decision: Mark the unit the team should kill next.
description.positioning: Mid row.
description.counterplay: Shields and healing on the cursed unit.
description.recognition: A doll icon hangs above the cursed enemy.

skill.name: Hex of Frailty
skill.text: Curses the current target: magic damage, and it takes more damage from every source for 5 seconds.

description.form: Stitched-together surgeon with mismatched arms and a tool belt.
description.decision: Keep a damaged front-liner standing.
description.positioning: Second row.
description.counterplay: Burst past the shield; dive him.
description.recognition: Thread stitches across the ally and a pale shield appears.

skill.name: Patch Up
skill.text: Heals the allied unit with the lowest health, then gives it a shield for 4 seconds.

description.form: Gaunt robed figure with a crown of candles and a scythe.
description.decision: Grow stronger as the fight goes on.
description.positioning: Back row; long fights favour him.
description.allies: Summoners; Tanks that prolong the fight.
description.counterplay: Kill him early; area damage.
description.recognition: Green light rises from a fallen unit's cell.

skill.name: Raise Dead
skill.text: Raises up to 2 skeletons where heroes or monsters have fallen. He waits until someone has fallen. A side may have 4 summoned units at once.

description.form: Boulder-bodied figure with glowing cracks and oversized fists.
description.decision: Split the enemy formation or block a lane.
description.positioning: Front-centre facing the enemy's approach.
description.allies: Snipers and Mages who gain time.
description.counterplay: Walk around; ranged units ignore it.
description.recognition: Stone pillars rise from marked cells.

skill.name: Rock Wall
skill.text: Raises 3 rock walls next to the current target for 4 seconds. Walls block cells and can be attacked, but do nothing themselves.

description.form: Cloud-bodied spirit with lightning arms and a bright core.
description.decision: Punish enemies standing next to each other.
description.positioning: Back row.
description.counterplay: Leave gaps between units.
description.recognition: A bolt visibly jumps from enemy to enemy.

skill.name: Chain Lightning
skill.text: Strikes the current target with lightning that jumps to up to 3 more enemies within 2 cells of each one hit.

description.form: Broad horned dragonkin with plated scales and a spiked tail.
description.decision: Punish enemies that focus him.
description.positioning: Front row.
description.counterplay: Stop attacking him while the scales glow; use skill damage.
description.recognition: Scales glow gold and sparks fly back at attackers.

skill.name: Thorn Scales
skill.text: Raises thorned scales for 4 seconds: attackers take 30% / 45% / 65% of the damage they deal back as true damage.

description.form: Slender winged dragonkin in white robes with a sun disc.
description.decision: Reset the whole team's health once.
description.positioning: Back row, protected.
description.counterplay: Burst single targets; reduce healing.
description.recognition: A sunrise glow sweeps across the allied side.

skill.name: Dawn Chorus
skill.text: Heals every wounded ally, herself included.

description.form: Tall crowned dragonkin with large wings and a red mantle.
description.decision: Late-game cone damage from the second row.
description.positioning: Second row facing the enemy cluster.
description.counterplay: Flank him; spread wide.
description.recognition: He rears back, then a cone of fire covers marked cells.

skill.name: Regent's Breath
skill.text: Breathes fire toward the current target, dealing magic damage to every enemy in a wide cone 3 cells long.

description.form: Dark-scaled dragonkin with hollow glowing chest and tattered wings.
description.decision: Shut down an enemy team that relies on skills.
description.positioning: Near the enemy's casters.
description.counterplay: Rely on basic attacks; keep casters apart.
description.recognition: Blue wisps are pulled from enemies into his chest.

skill.name: Mana Devour
skill.text: Devours 50 / 75 / 100 mana from every enemy within 3 cells and silences them for 2.5 / 3.5 / 5 seconds. A silenced hero still attacks but cannot cast.

traits.name: Human
traits.bonus: All allies start combat with +10 / +20 mana.

traits.name: Elf
traits.bonus: Elves have a 20% / 40% chance to dodge basic attacks.

traits.name: Dwarf
traits.bonus: Dwarves start each fight with a shield worth 20% / 40% of their maximum health.

traits.name: Goblin
traits.bonus: Winning a fight against another player pays +1 / +2 gold.

traits.name: Orc
traits.bonus: Orcs gain +20% / +40% maximum health.

traits.name: Beastkin
traits.bonus: All allies gain +10% / +20% attack speed.

traits.name: Demon
traits.bonus: Demons deal +15% / +30% of their damage again as true damage.

traits.name: Undead
traits.bonus: All enemies lose armour, more with 4 Undead. The amounts are not set yet.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.bonus: All allies take 15% / 30% less damage from abilities.

traits.name: Dragonkin
traits.bonus: Dragonkin start combat with 50% / 100% mana.

traits.name: Tank
traits.bonus: Tanks gain +20 / +40 armour.

traits.name: Fighter
traits.bonus: Fighters gain +20% / +40% attack damage.

traits.name: Assassin
traits.bonus: Assassins gain 15% / 30% critical-hit chance on basic attacks and leap behind the farthest enemy when the fight starts.

traits.name: Mage
traits.bonus: All allies deal 20% / 40% more skill damage.

traits.name: Sniper
traits.bonus: Snipers gain +1 / +2 attack range and +10% / +20% basic attack damage.

traits.name: Engineer
traits.bonus: All allies gain 3 / 6 extra mana every second.

traits.name: Warlock
traits.bonus: All allies heal for 10% / 20% of the damage they deal.

traits.name: Priest
traits.bonus: All allies regenerate 1.5% / 3% of their maximum health every second.

traits.name: Shaman
traits.bonus: At combat start, 1 / 2 random enemies are hexed for 3 seconds: they can walk but cannot attack, cast or gain mana.

traits.name: Summoner
traits.bonus: Summoned units gain +30% / +60% health and damage.

relics.name: Heavy Bloom
relics.text: +30% skill power (skill damage, healing and shields).

relics.name: Quick Wick
relics.text: Skills come 20% sooner and +10% attack speed.
